# Security Contacts

Primary maintainer: `@SmartyJohnway`

Use GitHub private vulnerability reporting for this repository whenever available:

https://github.com/SmartyJohnway/universal-file-to-markdown/security/advisories/new

Do not include confidential source documents in a vulnerability report. Use synthetic reproductions and redact document text, credentials, paths, and personal data.

See `SECURITY.md` for the supported versions and disclosure process.
